newsitem.title: FRANCE: Signaux plans to buy CEA's stake in Cisi.
newsitem.headline: Signaux plans to buy CEA's stake in Cisi.

text.p: French electronics group Cie des Signaux said on Monday it concluded a draft agreement to buy state-owned CEA-Industrie 64 percent stake in Cisi Holding, an affiliate of French computer systems house Cap Gemini.
Cie des Signaux said in a statement that it "had concluded a draft agreement for the sale by CEA-Industrie of its 64 percent stake in Cisi Holding."
CEA said in a statement there would be consultations with workers' representatives and the project would be submitted for approval to the authorities.
Cie des Signaux said its aim of doubling its size by June 1997 "will be virtually achieved with a sales of nearly four billion francs."
CEA said Cisi Holding had sales of about 1.15 billion francs in 1996. On February 11, Cie des Signaux reported a 12 percent rise in sales to 1.939 billion francs.
